name: AI-Generated Stock Photography / Illustrations

yield.notes: Per-image earnings are very low ($0.10-$2). Volume game — needs 500+ accepted images.

flags: Shutterstock/Adobe Stock have AI content policies — check before submitting
Copyright of AI images legally contested in some jurisdictions
Submission approval process can be slow (1-4 weeks)

prerequisites: Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion account
Adobe Creative Cloud or free alternatives for post-processing
startup_checklist: Review AI art submission policies for target platform (Adobe Stock, Shutterstock, Getty)
Generate first 100 images in commercially-viable niches (business, lifestyle, abstract)
Post-process images to meet technical requirements (minimum 4MP, no watermarks)
Submit batch and track approval rates
Scale to 500+ images once approval workflow is confirmed
failure_modes: Platform rejects AI submissions or changes policy
Market flooded with AI art, per-image rates drop
kill_criteria: Approval rate below 50% after first 100 submissions
Monthly earnings below $20 after 500 live images
sources_note: Earnings data from stock photography creator forums and published case studies.
